## What We Study

::: {.axis .axis--he}
<span class="axis-number">01</span>
<div>
### Human × Environment

How do people move through, and get exposed to, environmental risk? Extreme heat, human mobility, and spatial exposure in cities and regions.

<p class="axis-keywords">extreme heat · human mobility · spatial exposure · urban environment · spatial analysis</p>
</div>
:::

::: {.axis .axis--ei}
<span class="axis-number">02</span>
<div>
### Environment × Information

How are nature and biodiversity represented in the information space? Conservation culturomics and biodiversity perception through digital corpora.

<p class="axis-keywords">biodiversity · conservation culturomics · wildlife trade · human–nature relationships · biodiversity perception</p>
</div>
:::

::: {.axis .axis--hi}
<span class="axis-number">03</span>
<div>
### Human × Information

How is knowledge about nature and science structured across languages and platforms? Multilingual Wikipedia, natural language processing, and knowledge graphs.

<p class="axis-keywords">Wikipedia · multilingual data · NLP · knowledge graphs · network science · LLM evaluation</p>
</div>
:::
